mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth does not correlate with earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) over the past two months signals a broad-based increase in demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with joint increases in HOUST and GDPC1, or the joint increase does not correlate with earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month, coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >200k MoM and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE do not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past month signals a loosening monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decreases do not correlate with subsequent equity market performance.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past two months signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decreases do not correlate with subsequent earnings declines.
